instruments.reason: UNVERIFIED is about the TARGET, not the instrument: this repository carries no browser measurement for an arbitrary head, so a verifier must run it at theirs. Wave 4 made that possible anywhere — Playwright is discovered (PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE, bare specifier, npm root -g, interpreter-relative) instead of imported from one machine's absolute path (P2K-F06) — and made the result readable by mapping each outcome to its own exit code (PASS->0, FAIL->1, UNVERIFIED->3, ERROR->4), with zero checks and zero failures classified ERROR rather than PASS. Wave 6 extended both halves to the other four harnesses, which Wave 4 had left on the absolute path.

instruments.target: no input in the corpus that the base revision rejects is accepted by the target
instruments.oracle: the base revision's own verdicts, over a corpus independent of both revisions; attribution comes from each side's own error message
sharedDependencies: none: the corpus owns its committed threat list and imports nothing from project-config (pinned by P2K-D01)
instruments.positiveControl: tools/verification/experiments/corpus-independence.mjs regenerates 26496 and 40000 and cross-checks them against a committed expectations file; mutants K3-01..K3-09 cover the corpus repair itself
instruments.negativeControl: base and target identical produces 0 in every bucket
instruments.proves: that no corpus input the base rejects is accepted by the target, that every hard rule and every advisory rule is exercised by at least one input, and which rule each rejection is attributed to on each side
instruments.doesNotProve: completeness. The corpus is a finite enumerated threat list and cannot reach open-set forms — confusable homoglyphs, spelled-out separators, bracketed dots (QD-J13). A re-attribution count also does not bound how far a rule weakened, only that attribution moved.
instruments.reason: P2K-F01 repaired in Wave 3. The corpus was quarantined because it derived DOT_EQUIVALENTS from the module under test and took the extension source from the head under test, so a commit that shrank either constant shrank the corpus policing it. The corpus now owns its threat list and imports nothing from project-config (pinned structurally by P2K-D01). Re-measured on Wave 0's two experiments, exactly as Wave 0 made them: dropping one dot equivalent gives 26496 regressions, dropping five extension atoms gives 40000, both exit 1, where the derived corpus gave 0 for both. Regenerate with tools/verification/experiments/corpus-independence.mjs, which fails if the measurement disagrees with its committed expectations file. Wave 3 first published 32000 for the second figure; that came from a FOUR-atom mutation, not Wave 0's five, and the two were wrongly described as the same experiment.

Wave 1 listed it as ADMISSIBLE, which pre-certified the review a verifier was being asked to perform — a verdict handed over rather than reached. UNVERIFIED is the honest value: a review exists only once someone runs one and records it against a named head.

instruments.target: distinguishing SURVIVED from EQUIVALENT for a mutant no test killed
instruments.oracle: the generic equivalence probe, which observes the guard's public text API over the committed corpus
sharedDependencies: the generic probe is guard-corpus-based, so it cannot adjudicate a mutant outside that behavioural surface
instruments.positiveControl: QD-J21: a probe that recorded only rule names reported a gutted advisory message as equivalent; the probe now records rule, severity and message
instruments.negativeControl: for a mutant in a file the probe cannot observe, the harness reports non-killed rather than asserting equivalence
instruments.proves: nothing on its own. A generic non-killed result means SURVIVED_OR_EQUIVALENT_UNDETERMINED unless a separate operator-specific measurement resolves it
instruments.doesNotProve: that a non-killed mutant is equivalent. EQUIVALENT is only as good as the probe's resolution, and outside project-config/evidence.js the generic probe has none
instruments.reason: Human Gate, Phase 2K final classification: the single DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY label on 'mutation' was too coarse, because it understated the KILLED verdict (decided by npm test, admissible) in order to describe the non-kill split honestly. The two claims are now classified separately. This half stays DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: the generic automatic equivalence probe is guard-corpus-based and cannot adjudicate arbitrary mutants outside that behavioural surface, so a generic non-killed result is SURVIVED_OR_EQUIVALENT_UNDETERMINED. K2-03 is the worked example — the battery reports it non-killed, and a SEPARATE focused measurement of Dirent behaviour established equivalence for that one operator in that one environment. That equivalence result belongs to the focused measurement, not to this instrument.

knownLimitations.statement: guard-diff and its corpus are blind to any change that shrinks a production constant the corpus derives from. Measured twice; each made the guard accept a private-document filename while the differential reported REGRESSIONS 0.
the corpus has no positive control: nothing checks it contains the inputs it is meant to contain.
knownLimitations.status: CLOSED in Wave 3 — hard and advisory rule coverage are both checked and a gap exits non-zero; the check found control-character never exercised

knownLimitations.statement: diff-heads records only the first matching rule, so a rule masked by an earlier one is invisible.
knownLimitations.status: PARTIALLY CLOSED in Wave 3 — an attribution shift between two rules is now recorded and reported (the reattributed bucket). First-match attribution remains the mechanism, so how far a rule weakened is still not bounded

knownLimitations.statement: the browser check imported Playwright from one machine's absolute path, so a fresh verifier could not run it. The larger half was that a failed import died with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, making 'never ran' indistinguishable from 'ran and failed' — which is what §18's 'UNVERIFIED is acceptable' depends on.
knownLimitations.status: CLOSED in Wave 6 — Wave 4 converted one of five harnesses and recorded the finding as closed; an independent verifier applied the repair's own structural test to the whole directory and found the other four still on the absolute path. All five now share harness.mjs, and the UNVERIFIED exit was demonstrated for each

knownLimitations.statement: inputDigest now has a schema slot, but no instrument computes an independent corpus digest yet.
makeEvidence can construct Evidence whose prose carries a demoted form, and the candidate serializer copies it; the lint inspects committed config only. Inert while observations are 0.

publication-lint discovery was non-recursive in BOTH the implementation and its test. Measured: three publication-facing values planted one directory down — one tripping a HARD rule — were reported as zero, and the shipped suite stayed green.
knownLimitations.status: CLOSED in Wave 2 — discovery is recursive (D-006); the test oracles are a hand-written literal, git ls-files, and a tree the test builds, so no walker is shared with the implementation

knownLimitations.statement: the lint's expected-side walker is structurally the same algorithm as the implementation's; what breaks the symmetry is FP-01b's hardcoded literal paths.
colon-labelled yen prices are rejected by windows-absolute-path. Accepted cost of the Phase 2J fail-closed decision.

an instrument that spawns a child reads differently depending on who invoked it: NODE_TEST_CONTEXT leaking into the child makes `node --test` print no summary and exit 0 even when a test fails. Measured in the mutation harness on a mutant it otherwise reports KILLED: clean env gave exit 1 with 5 'not ok' lines, the leaked env gave exit 0 with no TAP at all, which the harness read as 'no test failed' — every operator in such a battery reports SURVIVED behind a normal-looking table.
knownLimitations.status: CLOSED in Wave 3 for the mutation harness and the Wave 2 experiment (env sanitised; no TAP summary or disagreeing signals is a HARNESS ERROR). diff-heads spawns only git, which is unaffected.

knownLimitations.statement: the mutation harness reports the symlink-guard operator as NON-KILLED, and does not assert equivalence. A SEPARATE focused measurement established equivalence for it: removing the guard produced byte-identical output on a tree with file, directory and cyclic symlinks, because withFileTypes already reports isDirectory() and isFile() as false for a symlink. That equivalence belongs to the focused measurement, not to the harness, and holds for THIS filesystem and Node version; a filesystem returning DT_UNKNOWN was not tested. Regenerate with tools/verification/experiments/dirent-symlink.mjs.
knownLimitations.status: equivalent by separate focused measurement — guard kept as defence in depth

knownLimitations.statement: the differential corpus is a finite enumerated threat list. It now exercises every hard and advisory rule and is independent of the subject, but it cannot reach open-set forms: confusable homoglyphs, spelled-out separators, bracketed dots. A REGRESSIONS: 0 is a statement about this corpus, whose digest is printed beside it, and never about the guard in general.
knownLimitations.status: open by construction — not repairable, only stated

knownLimitations.statement: a generic non-killed mutation result is SURVIVED_OR_EQUIVALENT_UNDETERMINED. The automatic equivalence probe observes the guard's public text API over the committed corpus, so for a mutant in any other file it has no resolution at all. K2-03 is reported non-killed by the battery; its EQUIVALENT status comes from a separate focused measurement of readdirSync(withFileTypes) Dirent behaviour on this filesystem and Node version, and is attributed to that measurement rather than to the harness.
knownLimitations.status: open by construction — classified rather than repaired (Human Gate, Phase 2K)

evidenceStateExpected.note: Hand-written expectation, NOT read from the tree. A verifier runs `node tools/verification/project-state-probe.mjs` and compares its output against these values. Disagreement is a finding, not a tolerance. 'project' and 'preset' are the CURRENT PUBLIC RUNTIME state (the runtime-default built-in, the synthetic sample); 'protectedCalculations' are algorithm regression fixtures with fixed inputs, independent of the runtime preset. The legacy project preset and its Phase 2L-A intake are legacy validation data and are not described here.
